questions.q: How many Lagaan (vowel symbols) are there in Punjabi?
questions.exp: There are 10 Lagaan in the Punjabi language.
Aira takes 4 Lagaan: Mukta, Kanna, Dulavan, and Kanaura.

questions.q: Which Lagaan does NOT attach to 'ੳ' (Oora)?
questions.exp: Sihari does not attach to Oora. It attaches to Eeri.

questions.q: Which of these is the '3, 4, 3' formula referring to?
opts: Number of Lagaan for ੳ, ਅ, ੲ
questions.exp: It refers to the number of Lagaan attached to the vowel bearers ੳ (3), ਅ (4), and ੲ (3).
Eeri never takes a Kanna. It only takes Sihari, Bihari, and Lavan.

A symbol for a doubled consonant
questions.exp: Mukta means the letter is free from any visible vowel symbol.

questions.q: Which vowel bearer takes the 'Hora' symbol?
questions.exp: Oora takes Hora. It often takes an open top form (ਓ).
Eeri takes Sihari, Bihari, and Lavan.
